text_block_list.text:
You worked so hard, didn't you?
Good girl, good girl... Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, right, would it be alright
if I left a few of them in the Trainer's Office?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I thought I'd like to take care of these little ones together with just the two of us, Trainer.
